resolution: Set process-local ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_SDK_ROOT to D:\ProgramCode\Android\Sdk and verified the SDK directory plus platforms/build-tools. The retry will retain JDK 21 and the exact frozen Gradle invocation.
diagnosis: The frozen Android JVM Gradle command stopped during configuration before the selected tests ran. At failure, ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_SDK_ROOT were unset although D:\ProgramCode\Android\Sdk exists and contains platforms and build-tools.
